create_background_task: create a BackgroundTask with an init function and process function for multiprocessing
start_background_task: start a BackgroundTask process with an optional exec_empty flag for idle execution
put_get_background_task: put arguments into a BackgroundTask send queue and get results from the receive queue
create_propagating_thread: create a PropagatingThread that propagates exceptions back to the parent thread on join
create_exception_process: create a Process subclass that returns child exceptions to the parent via a Pipe
